### Added

- (gs) [Add the Platform cluster page's SSH access tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3626) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Where the Platform section is turned on (`gs.features.platformSection.enabled`), a cluster's page has an SSH access tab with the commands to reach its nodes. Only Giant Swarm staff see the tab.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Distinguish model configuration from readiness](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3629) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On Customize › Models and a model's page, a provider model whose settings were accepted reads `Configured` instead of `Ready`, with the hint `Settings accepted. Provider access has not been tested.` Locally served models keep their serving status.
- (several plugins) [Keep agent toolset checks from blocking the wizard](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3630) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — In the Tools step of creating or editing an agent, `Continue` works while the tools are still being checked, and a check that gets no answer gives up after five seconds; a selection that is refused still blocks `Continue` and says why.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.45.1...v3.46.0
